top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a falsifiable prediction (flat bands at a magic angle, 2011) followed by the 2018 discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, since reproduced by independent groups and extended to twisted multilayers and moire TMDs. The citation, worded around the prediction and observed phases with no claim on the pairing mechanism, does not depend on the open part of the field; the three-name allocation (MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer) is defensible though the thin experimental credit is a real reservation. P002 (Katori, Ye) is a clean, mature, sharply attributed second choice, but a narrower step and partly builds on already honoured comb and ion-control work. Both are preferable to no award.
